title: Purple Mage Dancer
description: A young female character with white hair in buns and purple eyes stands in a dynamic pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-inspired outfit with a corset-style top, flowing sleeves, and wide pants, casting glowing purple magical energy from both hands while a crackling purple halo floats above her head.
